title: Pretend feeding uses a block as if it were a snack
summary: By about 30 months, most children pretend with objects, such as feeding a block to a doll as if the block were food, the U.S. CDC says.
body: Using things to pretend, like feeding a block to a doll as if it were food, is a cognitive milestone on the CDC 30-month page. The printed meaning of most is 75 percent or more of children by the age given. CDC states that Learn the Signs materials are not a substitute for standardized, validated developmental screening tools. Pointing out a color, and climbing a stool to reach an item, are other lines and stay off this card. Here a block stands in for a snack during play. That is not a diagnosis, and a foreign checklist may never mention dolls.
